deterministicEvidence.rootCause: Commit b22e325 added `canIssueAuthorityTokens: false` to the R0 authority block emitted by src/lab/zeknova-controlled-evaluation.js. That field is inside the decision packet, so the packet's self-hash changed. artifacts/deterministic-evidence.json was never regenerated afterwards.
deterministicEvidence.note: The change tightens the R0 denial block by explicitly denying authority-token issuance. It is a safety strengthening, not a weakening, and every other check in every other report is byte-identical.

reconciliationPolicy: The inventory and the deterministic evidence artifact are regenerated ONLY after every divergence above has been individually explained and classified. No hash was regenerated to obtain a green result.
